name: Dafiology full-frame (one plate a scene, camera grammar)
description: One full-frame plate a scene, pushed and drifted by a measured camera, with a value-coloured readout chip, a callout tag and the hook burned in for the first 1.6 s. Frames drawn with Pillow.

cautions: Every scene is one still: the motion has to come from the push, the drift and the breath, never from a moving picture.
The readout chip is metadata, not a second subtitle. Its text stays short enough to fit one line at the top right.
The callout tag sits under the bar at the top left so it never covers the subject's face.

provenance.ref: Hermes profile: skills/creative/flat-vector-explainer-video, skills/creative/stickman-chikoomollian and the ChikooTale engine at /opt/data/ep01_robotfist/engine.py (EP21-EP23, rendered 15-19 Nov 2026)
provenance.notes: The camera grammar (push that settles, 2.6/3.4 px breath, hard cuts), the value-coloured readout chip, the callout tag and the 1.6 s hook are taken from that engine, which rendered three published episodes at 720x1280. The actor rig, the story audio, the end card and the meter's event cues are out of scope in 0.1.0: this version moves plates, not sprites.
